what: BN5's Liberation Missions hold no special route (docs/game/liberation/special-routes.md; docs/research/sources.md): the item kinds' table 0x08051924 ends after six records (BN5_LIB_ITEM_KIND_COUNT; its seventh, 0x08051954, is Thumb code), the nine missions' item lists hold kinds 0-5 alone and their panel lists kinds 0, 1, 3, 5-7 and 9-0x0C alone; the route a sealed region holds is ours, kept for the run and opening a third way at the next fork
